text:
sam: ok serious question 1: do we need a Biscuit Council? i feel like our snack governance is chaotic.

tereza: yes. bylaws please. clause 1: no soggy biscuits in communal tins. i'm not debating this.

kai: proposal: rotating Biscuit Steward who hallows the tin every monday. duties: snack inventory, biscuit feng shui, and emergency crumb cleanup.

ivy: does the steward get a title? i call dibs on "Keeper of Crunch".

ops-bot: Poll created: "Establish Biscuit Council and Steward role?" Options: yes, no, only if steward gets hat

marc: i'll fund the hat. felt or beanie? beanie is peak energy.

sam: if there is a hat there must be an oath. suggested oath: "i solemnly swear to protect the biscuit tin from betrayal and stale biscuits". sign with a coffee ring.

tereza: mandatory training: biscuit recognition and crumb diplomacy. also annual tin audit.

kai: can we add honorary members like fernus (plant) and the Great Fridge (rip)?

ivy: frank the fridge retired last spring. may his hummus rest in peace.

ops-bot: Poll results: yes 3, no 1, hat-only 1. Biscuit Council formed. Please nominate first Steward.

sam: nominations: tereza (experienced), kai (energetic), ivy (has label maker).

tereza: i accept if oath is performed dramatically and biscuits are quality-checked weekly.

marc: ceremonials approved. i will create a parchment (ok, sticky note) and draw a tiny crest.

ivy: can we add a sash? i'm variant-curious.

kai: sash + hat + tiny gavel (for crumb arbitration).

sam: inaugural investiture this friday at 10am near the kettle. bring biscuits, bring opinions. :tea:

tereza: long live the Biscuit Council. may our tins be ever crisp. :cookie:
